periods.analysis: Q1 actions: Met with district student services, which deferred any discipline policy discussion until after spring testing. Collected substance-related discipline data from two high schools. Partners: Harborview Unified School District, Education department.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Present a draft restorative-response model to district student services and identify pilot campuses.

periods.analysis: Q2 actions: Shared the draft restorative-response model with student services, but no campus agreed to pilot it as the school year closed. Counselors at two high schools volunteered for training. Partners: Harborview Unified School District, Education department, Coastal Behavioral Health.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Present the restorative-response model to district leaders and train counselors at the two volunteer high schools.

periods.analysis: Q3 actions: Presented a restorative-response model to district leaders and trained counselors at two high schools. Only two of nine campuses have adopted it, mostly because new-year staffing took priority. Partners: Harborview Unified School District, Education department, Coastal Behavioral Health.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Draft model language for the student code of conduct and bring it to the school board's October work session; secure a district liaison.
